newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to sell May 25-27 naphtha, LNG.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to sell May 25-27 naphtha, LNG.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to sell 30,000 tonnes of May high aromatic naphtha (HAN) and 25,000 tonnes of liquefied natural gas (LNG), industry sources said on Tuesday.
Both cargoes are for loading between May 25-27.
Traders said the HAN supplies will be loaded from Cochin and the LNG from Hazirah, both on the Indian west coast.
The tender closes May 16 and is valid for one day.
In its last tender, IOC sold 30,000 tonnes of HAN at a record low price of around $40 a tonne below Japanese spot quotes for May 6-7 lifting free-on-board Cochin.
